storage.built_in: 64, 96, 128 or 157 TB effective by model, RAID 6; OS on 2 x M.2 SSD, RAID 1

power.supply: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, auto-switching; dual redundant, hot-swappable

features: 2 x 10 GbE SFP+ ports in addition to the 6 x 1 GbE RJ-45 ports
Max. cameras for Appearance Search only 200, Face Recognition + Appearance Search 50
notes: Recording rate is up to 1500 Mbps on 10 GbE multiple connections and up to 700 Mbps on 1 GbE multiple connections.
Outgoing bandwidth is the stated playback rate while recording.
Datasheet specification table gives up to 180 TB raw; its ordering information gives 192 TB raw for the 157 TB model.
Datasheet gives average power consumption of 333 W (1+1) and maximum of 750 W.
Camera channel count is not stated in the datasheet.
